```{r}
data <- raw_excel %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

rm(raw_excel)
  

# Numeric robust aus Text (Komma/Punkt etc.)
to_num <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  x_chr <- gsub(",", ".", x_chr)
  x_chr <- gsub("[^0-9\\+\\-\\.eE]", "", x_chr)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))
}


## load data in the correct format

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    # --- Date ---
    date = as.Date(as.numeric(date), origin ="1899-12-30"),

    # --- Character ---
    data_provider      = as.character(data_provider),
    remark_raw_data           = as.character(remark_raw_data),
    remark_import             = as.character(remark_import),
    pit_dec                   = as.character(pit_dec),
    pit_hex                   = as.character(pit_hex),
    
    #Faktor
    country            = as.factor(country),
    river_name         = as.factor(river_name),
    source             = as.character(source),

    site_name          = as.factor(site_name),
    method             = as.factor(method),

    species            = as.factor(species),
```

# 3 - Load Functions

```{r}

#Seber-LeCren 

## working

seber_le_cren_est <- function(C1, C2) {
  
  C1 <- as.numeric(C1)[1]
  C2 <- as.numeric(C2)[1]
  
  if (!is.finite(C1) || !is.finite(C2)) {
    return(tibble(
      N = NA_real_,
      Var_N = NA_real_,
      sd_N = NA_real_,
      CI_95 = NA_real_,
      N_min = NA_real_,
      N_max = NA_real_,
      ok = FALSE,
      msg = "Missing or non-numeric C1/C2"
    ))
  }
  
  if (C1 <= 0) {
    return(tibble(
      N = NA_real_,
      Var_N = NA_real_,
      sd_N = NA_real_,
      CI_95 = NA_real_,
      N_min = NA_real_,
      N_max = NA_real_,
      ok = FALSE,
      msg = "C1 must be > 0"
    ))
  }
  
  if (C2 >= C1) {
    return(tibble(
      N = NA_real_,
      Var_N = NA_real_,
      sd_N = NA_real_,
      CI_95 = NA_real_,
      N_min = NA_real_,
      N_max = NA_real_,
      ok = FALSE,
      msg = "C2 must be smaller than C1"
    ))
  }
  
  N <- C1^2 / (C1 - C2)
  Var_N <- (C1^2 * C2^2 * (C1 + C2)) / (C1 - C2)^4
  sd_N <- sqrt(Var_N)
  CI_95 <- 2 * sd_N
  
  tibble(
    N = round(N, 0),
    Var_N = round(Var_N, 2),
    sd_N = round(sd_N, 1),
    CI_95 = round(CI_95, 0),
    N_min = round(N - CI_95, 0),
    N_max = round(N + CI_95, 0),
    ok = TRUE,
    msg = NA_character_
  )
}

#DeLury 
delury_est <- function(counts) {
  
  counts <- as.numeric(counts)

  out_na <- function(msg, N = NA_real_) {
    tibble(
      N     = N,
      Var_N = NA_real_,
      sd_N  = NA_real_,
      CI_95 = NA_real_,
      N_min = NA_real_,
      N_max = NA_real_,
      ok    = FALSE,
      msg   = msg
    )
  }
  #checks for missing or non numeric values
  if (any(!is.finite(counts))) {
    return(out_na("Missing or non-numeric counts"))
  }
  
  #checks number of runs
  if (length(counts) < 3) {
    return(out_na("DeLury needs >= 3 passes"))
  }
  
  #checks if catches are positive
  if (any(counts < 0)) {
    return(out_na("Counts must be >= 0"))
  }
  
  #checks if catches are zero
  if (sum(counts) == 0) {
    return(out_na("No fish caught"))
  }
  
  #checks varation in runs - catches must be different for each run
  if (length(unique(counts)) < 2) {
    return(out_na("No depletion (all counts equal)"))
  }
  
  # y = catches in run, x = cumulative catch before run
  df <- tibble(
    catch        = counts,
    CumCatchPrev = c(0, cumsum(counts)[-length(counts)])
  )
  
  #checks if linear model can be fitted
  fit <- try(lm(catch ~ CumCatchPrev, data = df), silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    return(out_na("LM failed"))
  }
  
  a <- unname(coef(fit)["(Intercept)"])
  b <- unname(coef(fit)["CumCatchPrev"])
  
  #checks if coefficients are valid
  if (!is.finite(a) || !is.finite(b)) {
    return(out_na("Coefficients could not be estimated"))
  }
  
  #checks if slope is negative
  if (b >= 0) {
    return(out_na("Slope must be negative (no depletion)"))
  }
  
  #checks if intercept is positive
  if (a <= 0) {
    return(out_na("Intercept must be > 0"))
  }
  
  #Estimate of population
  N <- a / (-b)
  
  #checks if estimated N is bigger than real catch
  if (N < sum(counts)) {
    return(out_na("N smaller than total catch", N = round(N, 0)))
  }
  
  # Calculate variance Delta Method - kann man das so machen?
  vc    <- vcov(fit)
  dN_da <- -1 / b
  dN_db <-  a / b^2
  
  Var_N <- dN_da^2 * vc[1, 1] +
           dN_db^2 * vc[2, 2] +
           2 * dN_da * dN_db * vc[1, 2]
  
  #checks if variance can be calculated 
  if (!is.finite(Var_N) || Var_N < 0) {
    return(out_na("Variance could not be estimated", N = round(N, 0)))
  }
  
  sd_N  <- sqrt(Var_N)
  CI_95 <- 2 * sd_N
  
#return of results 
  tibble(
    N     = round(N, 0),
    Var_N = round(Var_N, 2),
    sd_N  = round(sd_N, 1),
    CI_95 = round(CI_95, 0),
    N_min = round(N - CI_95, 0),
    N_max = round(N + CI_95, 0),
    ok    = TRUE,
    msg   = NA_character_
  )
}
```

#4 - Overview over sites fished -(number of species, individuals of species, totals)


```{r}

#add row for each species and number of species for each site

overview_data <- data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(site_name), !is.na(species)) %>% 
  group_by(river_name, site_name, species) %>% 
  summarise(
    Stelle = first(site_name), 
    `Befischte_Länge(m)` = first(fished_length),
    n_individuals = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species, 
    values_from = n_individuals, 
    values_fill = 0
  )

#extract species names 
species_cols <- setdiff(
  names(overview_data), 
  c("site_name", "river_name", "Stelle", "Befischte_Länge(m)")
)

#Summarize number of total individuals per site and number of different species 
overview_data <- overview_data %>% 
  mutate(
    Anzahl_Arten = rowSums(across(all_of(species_cols)) > 0, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Gesamtfangzahl = rowSums(across(all_of(species_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
    select(-site_name) %>% 
    relocate(Anzahl_Arten, Gesamtfangzahl, .after = Stelle)

#Summarize total number of fish of each species, total number of different species in sampling campain, total length fished, total number of fish caught

total_row_species_data <- overview_data %>% 
  summarise(
    Fluss = "Total",
    `Befischte_Länge(m)` = sum(`Befischte_Länge(m)`, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Anzahl_Arten = sum(colSums(across(all_of(species_cols)), na.rm = TRUE) > 0),
    Gesamtfangzahl = sum(Gesamtfangzahl, na.rm = TRUE), 
    across(all_of(species_cols), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
  
# bind rows 
overview_data <- bind_rows(overview_data, total_row_species_data)

# remove total row

rm(total_row_species_data)

# show table

overview_data






```

# 5 - Prepare Data for Wading

## 5.1. All Data

```{r}

#Summarize Data to get number of species per Site and number of species per Run in seperate columns

##Extract Number of Individuals per Species per run and site and total weight

dat_summary <- data %>%
  count(site_name, species, sample_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_id, 
    values_from = n, 
    names_glue = "Run_{sample_id}", 
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species_total = rowSums(across(any_of(c("Run_1", "Run_2", "Run_3"))), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) 

## Calculate weight per species per site 


dat_weight_species_sites <- data %>% 
  group_by(site_name, species) %>% 
  summarise(
    weight_g = round(sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    weight_kg = round(weight_g / 1000, 2),
    median_species_weight_g = round(median(weight, na.rm = TRUE),3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


#add median weight of all species per site 

dat_weight_site <- data %>% 
  group_by(site_name) %>% 
  summarise(
    median_weight_g_site = round(median(weight), 3), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  

## Add all other data 

dat_metadata <- data %>% 
  group_by(site_name, species) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      -c(sample_id, fish_id, total_length, weight, reader_id, pit_dec, pit_hex, remark_raw_data, remark_import), 
      first
    ),
      .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    fished_area = fished_length * fished_width,
    area_ha = fished_area / 10000
  )

##Put metadata back to dat

dat <- dat_metadata %>% 
  left_join(dat_summary, by = c("site_name", "species")) %>% 
  left_join(dat_weight_species_sites, by = c("site_name", "species")) %>% 
  left_join(dat_weight_site, by = "site_name")

## Remove unneeded dfs 

rm(dat_summary, dat_weight_species_sites, dat_weight_site, dat_metadata)

# Working fields
run_cols <- grep("^Run_", names(dat), value = TRUE)


```

#/
##5.2. - Abundance per Species

```{r}


#Calculate estimated abundance, sd, CI, Var_N and N_min, N_max
## all lengths


slc_species <- dat_75 %>%
  filter(assessment == "Seber-LeCren") %>% 
  mutate(
    C1 = as.numeric(Run_1),
    C2 = as.numeric(Run_2),
    est = map2(C1, C2, seber_le_cren_est)
  ) %>%
  unnest(est)



## Calculate estimates of abundance on species and site level per area and length



slc_species <- slc_species %>% 
  mutate(
    #total number of individuals per site and species
    N_real = C1 + C2, 
    #number of estimated individuals per site and species
    N_estimate = ifelse(ok, pmax(N-N_real, 0), NA_real_), 
    #weight of estimated (extra) fish 
    weight_calc_kg = N_estimate * median_species_weight_g / 1000, 
    #total biomass per site and species 
    biomass_total_kg = weight_kg + weight_calc_kg,
    #N per ha 
    N_per_ha = ifelse(ok & area_ha > 0, N / area_ha, NA_real_), 
    #N per 100 meter
    N_per_100m = ifelse(ok & fished_length > 0, N / fished_length * 100, NA_real_), 
    # Biomass per ha (kg)
    biomass_kg_ha = ifelse(ok & area_ha > 0, biomass_total_kg / area_ha, NA_real_), 
    #Biomass per 100 m (kg)
    biomass_per_100m_kg = ifelse(ok & fished_length > 0, biomass_total_kg / fished_length * 100, NA_real_)
  )


slc_species

```

####5.2.1. Reorganize for output

```{r}
#round values 

slc_species_output <- slc_species %>%
  mutate(
    N = round(N, 0),
    N_min = round(N_min, 0),
    N_max = round(N_max, 0),
    Var_N = round(Var_N, 2),
    sd_N = round(sd_N, 1),
    CI_95 = round(CI_95, 0),

    N_per_ha = round(N_per_ha, 0),
    N_per_100m = round(N_per_100m, 0),

    weight_kg = round(weight_kg, 3),
    weight_calc_kg = round(weight_calc_kg, 3),
    biomass_total_kg = round(biomass_total_kg, 3),
    biomass_kg_ha = round(biomass_kg_ha, 2),
    biomass_per_100m_kg = round(biomass_per_100m_kg, 2)
  )

```



### 5.2.2. Site Level: Abundance and Biomass


```{r}

# Estimates for all species for each site. Estimates calculated by Seber LeCren
# For biomass sum of weight of calculated N per species is used. 
### for Ögf only bigger than 75cm - check!  

slc_site <- slc_species %>% 
  filter(assessment == "Seber-LeCren") %>% 
  group_by(river_name, site_name) %>% 
  summarise(
    C1_site = sum(C1, na.rm = TRUE), 
    C2_site = sum(C2, na.rm = TRUE), 
    fished_length = first(fished_length), 
    fished_width = first(fished_width), 
    fished_area = first(fished_area), 
    area_ha = first(area_ha), 
    n_species = n_distinct(species), 
    weight_real_kg = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE), 
    biomass_species_sum_kg = sum(biomass_total_kg, na.rm = TRUE), 
    species_total = first(species_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    est = map2(C1_site, C2_site, seber_le_cren_est)
  ) %>% 
  unnest(est) %>% 
  mutate(
    #Abundance estimates per ha, 100 meter 
    N_site = N,
    N_per_ha = ifelse(area_ha >0, N_site / area_ha, NA_real_), 
    N_per_100m = ifelse(fished_length > 0, N_site / fished_length * 100, NA_real_), 
    #Biomass estimates per ha, 100 meter
    biomass_kg_ha = ifelse(area_ha > 0, biomass_species_sum_kg / area_ha, NA_real_), 
    biomass_per_100m_kg = ifelse(fished_length > 0, biomass_species_sum_kg / fished_length * 100, NA_real_)
  )

#Show Output

slc_site

```

```{r}
    N_per_ha = round(N_per_ha, 0),

    weight_real_kg = round(weight_real_kg, 3),
    biomass_species_sum_kg = round(biomass_species_sum_kg, 3),
    biomass_kg_ha = round(biomass_kg_ha, 2),
```

## 5.3. - ÖFG150 Abundance for totals and share of species


```{r}

## Calculate abundance and biomass per totals of each site - estimate species abundance by share of totals. 


site_slc_total <- dat_75 %>% 
  group_by(river_name, site_name) %>% 
  summarise(
    C1_site = sum(Run_1, na.rm = TRUE), 
    C2_site = sum(Run_2, na.rm = TRUE),
    fished_length = first(fished_length), 
    fished_width = first(fished_width), 
    fished_area = first(fished_area), 
    area_ha = first(area_ha), 
    n_species = n_distinct(species), 
    weight_real_kg = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE), 
    species_total = first(species_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    est = map2(C1_site, C2_site, seber_le_cren_est)
  ) %>% 
  unnest(est) %>% 
  mutate(
    #Abundance estimates per ha, 100 meter 
    N_site = N,
    N_per_ha = ifelse(area_ha > 0, N_site / area_ha, NA_real_), 
    N_per_100m = ifelse(fished_length > 0, N_site / fished_length * 100, NA_real_)
  )



species_prop <- dat_75 %>% 
  left_join(
    site_slc_total %>% 
      select(river_name, site_name, C1_site, C2_site, N_site, N_per_ha, N_per_100m), 
    by = c("river_name", "site_name")) %>% 
  group_by(river_name, site_name) %>% 
  mutate(
    #Abundance
    species_share = species_total / sum(species_total, na.rm = TRUE), 
    N_prop = N_site * species_share, 
    N_prop_per_ha = N_prop / area_ha, 
    N_prop_per_100m = N_prop / fished_length * 100, 
    #Biomass
    N_calc = N_prop - species_total, 
    weight_calc_kg = N_calc * median_species_weight_g / 1000, 
    biomass_prop_kg = weight_kg + weight_calc_kg, 
    biomass_prop_kg_ha = ifelse(area_ha > 0, biomass_prop_kg / area_ha, NA_real_), 
    biomass_prop_kg_100m = ifelse(fished_length > 0, biomass_prop_kg / fished_length * 100, NA_real_)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(
    river_name, 
    site_name, 
    species, 
    area_ha, 
    fished_length, 
    Run_1, 
    Run_2, 
    species_total,
    C1_site, 
    C2_site, 
    N_site, 
    N_per_ha, 
    N_per_100m, 
    species_share, 
    N_prop, 
    N_prop_per_ha, 
    N_prop_per_100m,
    weight_kg,
    weight_calc_kg,
    biomass_prop_kg,
    biomass_prop_kg_ha, 
    biomass_prop_kg_100m, 
    
  )

#Add Sum of weight of all species to Seber-LeCren per site 


weight_sum_site <- species_prop %>% 
  group_by(site_name) %>% 
  summarise(
    biomass_site_total_kg = sum(biomass_prop_kg, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
 

site_slc_total <- site_slc_total %>% 
  left_join(weight_sum_site, by = "site_name") %>% 
  mutate(
    biomass_kg_ha = biomass_site_total_kg / area_ha, 
    biomass_kg_100m = biomass_site_total_kg /fished_length * 100
  )


#Show results 

site_slc_total


species_prop

```

## 6.4. Adapt the LF to specific needs

```{r}
#Function for Length frequency

plot_length_freq <- function(data, 
                              facet_var = "species",
                              color_var = NULL,
                              binwidth = 20,
                              x_breaks = NULL,
                              x_limits = NULL,
                              title = NULL,
                              show_n = TRUE,
                              free_scales = "free") {
  
  if (is.null(title)) title <- ""
  
  # N-Label
  if (show_n) {
    if (!is.null(color_var)) {
      text_df <- data %>%
        group_by(.data[[facet_var]], .data[[color_var]]) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
        group_by(.data[[facet_var]]) %>%
        summarise(label = paste(paste0(.data[[color_var]], ": n=", n), collapse = "\n"), .groups = "drop")
    } else {
      text_df <- data %>%
        group_by(.data[[facet_var]]) %>%
        summarise(label = paste0("n = ", n()), .groups = "drop")
    }
  }
  
  # Basis-Aesthetics
  if (!is.null(color_var)) {
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = total_length, fill = .data[[color_var]]))
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = total_length))
  }
  
  p <- p +
    geom_histogram(
      binwidth = binwidth,
      boundary = 0,
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.7,
      position = "stack"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Total length [mm]",
      breaks = if (!is.null(x_breaks)) x_breaks else waiver(),
      limits = x_limits
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Number of individuals") +
    theme_classic() +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 12)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet_var)), scales = free_scales)
  
  if (show_n) {
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = text_df,
      aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
}

##Plot desired length-frequency diagram 
##add needed values
##add filter 
##color_var = plot different values in different colors
##x_breaks = define breaks. e.g. x_breaks = seq(0,600, 50): min = 0, max = 600, breaks by 50mm
##free_scales: 


BF_Schwarza <- data %>% 
  filter(river_name == "Schwarza") %>% 
  filter(species == "Salmo trutta") %>% 
  plot_length_freq(
    facet_var = "site_name", 
    binwidth = 25,
    x_breaks = seq(0, 600, 50), 
    free_scales = "fixed",
    title = "Bachforelle"
  )

BF_Schwarza
```

#/
#8 - DeLury - share of species

```{r}

##Total DeLury over all species 

site_del_total <- dat_75 %>% 
  group_by(river_name, site_name) %>% 
  summarise(
    C1_site = sum(Run_1, na.rm = TRUE), 
    C2_site = sum(Run_2, na.rm = TRUE),
    C3_site = sum(Run_3, na.rm = TRUE),      
    fished_length = first(fished_length), 
    fished_width  = first(fished_width), 
    fished_area   = first(fished_area), 
    area_ha       = first(area_ha), 
    n_species     = n_distinct(species), 
    weight_real_kg = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE), 
    species_total  = first(species_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    est = pmap(list(C1_site, C2_site, C3_site), ~ delury_est(c(...)))
  ) %>% 
  unnest(est) %>% 
  mutate(
    N_site      = N,
    N_per_ha    = ifelse(area_ha > 0, N_site / area_ha, NA_real_), 
    N_per_100m  = ifelse(fished_length > 0, N_site / fished_length * 100, NA_real_)
  )

##Proportional calculation of N per species 

### Join data and calculate percentage of species

species_prop_del <- dat_75 %>% 
  left_join(
    site_del_total %>% 
      select(river_name, site_name, N_site, N_per_ha, N_per_100m), 
    by = c("river_name", "site_name")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(river_name, site_name) %>% 
  mutate(
    species_share   = species_total / sum(species_total, na.rm = TRUE), 
    N_prop          = N_site * species_share, 
    N_prop_per_ha   = N_prop / area_ha, 
    N_prop_per_100m = N_prop / fished_length * 100, 
    
    N_calc            = N_prop - species_total, 
    weight_calc_kg    = N_calc * median_species_weight_g / 1000, 
    biomass_prop_kg   = weight_kg + weight_calc_kg, 
    biomass_prop_kg_ha   = ifelse(area_ha > 0, biomass_prop_kg / area_ha, NA_real_), 
    biomass_prop_kg_100m = ifelse(fished_length > 0, biomass_prop_kg / fished_length * 100, NA_real_)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

##add weight
weight_sum_site_del <- species_prop_del %>% 
  group_by(site_name) %>% 
  summarise(biomass_site_total_kg = sum(biomass_prop_kg, na.rm = TRUE))

##combine weight and abundance 
site_del_total <- site_del_total %>% 
  left_join(weight_sum_site_del, by = "site_name") %>% 
  mutate(
    biomass_kg_ha   = biomass_site_total_kg / area_ha, 
    biomass_kg_100m = biomass_site_total_kg / fished_length * 100
  )


```
